description: Public address in the register cards' moves: the House and Senate floor, a state floor, committee hearings, public comment at a council or board, the chair running a meeting, and campaign remarks, victory and concession. Every part is a whole sentence said in public-domain federal records (the Congressional Record, hearings, EAC and FEC meetings), with record words as slots. Campaign sources (rallies, ads) give patterns only; their wording ships only when a federal record also says it. A sentence that claims something about the speaker's life or the place names the record fact it needs (requiresFacts); the engine says it only when that fact is in the record.

slots.name: A person's name from the records (the honoree, the speaker, a member).
slots.bill: A measure on the floor, as its record names it.
slots.place: A town, county or state, from the place records.
slots.years: A count of years, computed from dated records.
slots.year: A year from a dated record.
slots.office: An office, from the office records.
slots.school: A school, from the school record.
slots.employer: An employer, from the job record.
slots.pronoun: His, her or their, from the person's record.
slots.pronoun_obj: Him, her or them, from the person's record.
slots.number: A count from the records (children in the household).
slots.group: An organization the speaker belongs to, from the membership record.
slots.issue: What the speech is about: a measure or topic from the records.
slots.reason: Why the speaker runs, from their recorded cause.
slots.hardship: What the speaker lived through, from their own records (lose a job, close a business).
slots.goal: What the speaker wants done, from their recorded stance.
slots.did: What the opponent did, from the opponent's record.
slots.opponent: The other candidate, by name, from the contest record.
slots.date: Election day, from the contest record.
slots.state: What the speaker means to restore, as the record says it.

mining.rule: A shape is kept when at least 2 documents say it as a whole sentence and one of them is a public-domain record from 2015 or later, which is its source.
